subject: Studio saved-clip loop preview
independent_review: CLEAR: parent independently reviewed final source/native lifecycle, including RLock ownership, generation captured before the existing Stop, quiet admitted repeats, session/source guards, Destroy revocation, normal timer-error cleanup and natural-end explicit Loop.

requirement.behavior: Explicit loop preview of the selected saved clip using the existing player

reuse.donor_result: Both inspected donor clip controls and current production had one-shot preview. No alternate player/controller/schema adopted.

invariants: The first preview requires the existing explicit Preview action. The new loop action is separate and explicit.
Loop uses existing WavePlayer.set_ab_loop(0, actual duration), enable_repeat(True), poll(restart=False) and quiet-admitted restart_repeat.
Natural completion preserves the exact reviewed binding so a later explicit Loop click can start it; Stop, source/project/selection, player-session, Cancel, Close and Destroy revoke it.
Original files, project schema/fingerprints/revisions, output selection, provider/runtime, shared executor and retained cleanup owners are unchanged.
Automatic repeat never focuses a control or invokes speech. Explicit loop changes use the existing focused status.
Only the GUI owner accesses wx.Timer. Worker finalization revokes Python state first; queued GUI timer callbacks cannot restart after cleanup.
Failed native closure retains the existing player/editor/preview; timer-start refusal cannot arm an unseen loop and normal timer-stop errors remain visible.
Captured Destroy always queues the retained editor cleanup and skips the event even when the native timer wrapper is already deleted.

tests.original_assertions: Retained; original file is recovered exactly by removing the additive suffix and reversing three fixture-only bindings
tests.methodology: Actual immutable Project/Scene/Cue, actual PCM files, actual WavePlayer and play_when_quiet; only native MCI calls and GUI dispatch/timer are modeled
cases: Stop during rendering or quiet wait
Failed native Close retention and retry
Worker finalizer does not call wx
Timer start and normal stop failures
Late Loop/Disable/timer events after Close or Destroy
tests.deadlines: Existing tests and native deadlines unchanged

native.default: Existing native widgets/FFmpeg plus passive loop-control checks; no audio endpoint opened, loop playback reports NOT_RUN
native.admission: Both arguments required; exact output index and stable identity compared before playback; no endpoint fallback
optional_checks: Loaded module bytes equal the checked-out source under the actual installed package
Explicit first Preview, no automatic repeat
Natural preview completion before explicit Loop
At least two actual native repeats
Same exact output identity and preview/project/original bytes
Native Stop revokes binding and closes playback owner
native.previous_assertions: Every prior native assertion retained; inverse edits recover the complete original script
native.counts_note: Static call-site counts, not executed or dynamic check totals

requirements: Add relevant existing clip suites to both focused source/installed selector lists
Run the optional native playback mode only with the separately reviewed exact endpoint; endpoint-free component runners retain passive mode
Add the separately reviewed portable test_recording_windows_process module as requested by root

limits: No execution was available on the host.
Loop restarts use the existing 100 ms GUI poll plus quiet admission; no gapless/sample-accurate repetition or hearing quality is claimed.
The existing saved clip trim/duration defines the preview; this adds no new range store or automatic restore playback.
No refs, branches, PRs or published application artifacts changed.

user_help.scope: Additive concise Ukrainian usage; existing contents retained; source-reviewed and execution NOT_RUN.
